digest:
- Progressive completed its Snapshot Pro commercial telematics rollout, increasing incumbent competition. Nirvana must emphasize real-time coaching and loss control to win fleet accounts [1].
- BLS data shows couriers drove 59 percent of transportation job gains in October while trucking flatlined, validating strong vehicle counts for last-mile fleets entering peak season [2].
- US containerized imports hit a record 2.67 million TEUs in October, supporting near-term parcel delivery demand and growth for telematics-backed commercial auto fleets [7].
- Ivans reported average commercial auto renewal rates increased year-over-year in October despite month-over-month decreases, supporting disciplined pricing for Nirvana's underwriting models [3].
